reasons.GateStateStore.recordValidation: kept per its own doc comment (gate-state-store.ts): the only caller, LightweightGateSystem.validateContent, was deleted with GateValidator when every criteria type moved to a pipeline stage, leaving getSystemHealth's totalValidations/successRate/lastValidationTime fields with no producer. Deleting the writer without the health fields would leave a reader describing a number nothing computes; revives when 20-gate-review-stage.ts wires in ground-truth results, or gets killed together with the health fields in a follow-up row (R36, P4.52, 2026-09-17).
reasons.GateAccumulator.getBySource: sole test-observation window for add()'s live dedup/priority-override contract at entry-source granularity; getAll() (live, id-only) can't express it (P4.52/R36)
reasons.GateAccumulator.getEntries: sole test-observation window for add()'s live dedup/priority-override contract at entry-priority/metadata granularity; getAll() (live, id-only) can't express it (P4.52/R36)
reasons.GateAccumulator.getEntry: sole test-observation window for a single entry's live retryLimit metadata written by add(); getAll() (live, id-only) can't express it (P4.52/R36)
reasons.GateAccumulator.has: sole test-observation window for add()'s live existence-after-dedup contract; kept alongside getEntries/getEntry/getBySource for the same reason (P4.52/R36)
reasons.GateEnforcementAuthority.parseGateVerdic: deliberate read side of renderGateVerdict() (gate-verdict-renderer.ts) — its PER_GATE_HEADER constant names this method by file as the intended reader, and both sides are round-trip tested for losslessness; no pipeline stage currently acts on the parsed per-gate detail for an enforcement decision, which is a wiring gap for the plan owner to judge, not dead code (P4.52/R36)
